Name: Shroom Spotter Redux
Author: strobel1ght
Description:
This is the old [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/908]Shroom Spotter mod by TehPers[/url] revived for 1.5 (and now 1.6)

This mod just adds a mushroom icon on days when you'll find mushrooms in the mines. Hovering over that day on the calendar will list the floors you'll be able to find them on.

Compatible with [b][u]SDV 1.6[/u][/b]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]. 
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Shroom Spotter
Manifest.Description: Tells you which floor the shrooms will be on today.
